name: Voter turnout of voting-eligible population (presidential)

anchors.source: U.S. VEP presidential-year turnout has ranged ~51.7% (1996) to ~66.6% (2020). L=50 anchors below the modern-series low; U=75 anchors above the modern high toward a peer-democracy ceiling. Per NOTES.md §6.3, this v0.1 uses presidential-year turnout carried forward to intervening midterm-only years.
